catalog_claim.sql:
WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT
                    s.id
                FROM
                    email_sync_streams s
                    JOIN email_links l ON l.id = s.link_id
                WHERE
                    l.is_sync_active
                    AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                    AND l.provider = $2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                    AND s.provider = $2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                    AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                    AND s.kind = 'folder_catalog'
                    AND s.next_run_at <= now()
                    AND (s.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR s.provider_retry_at <= now())
                    AND (s.next_run_at,
                        s.id) >= (
                        SELECT
                            COALESCE(h.due, raw.due),
                            COALESCE(h.id, raw.id)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT
                                r.next_run_at AS due,
                                r.id,
                                r.link_id,
                                r.generation,
                                r.lease_until
                            FROM
                                email_sync_streams r
                            WHERE
                                r.provider = $2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                AND r.kind = 'folder_catalog'
                                AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                AND (r.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR r.provider_retry_at <= now())
                            ORDER BY
                                r.next_run_at,
                                r.id
                            LIMIT 1) raw
                    LEFT JOIN email_links ok ON ok.id = raw.link_id
                        AND ok.sync_generation = raw.generation
                        AND ok.provider = $2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                        AND ok.is_sync_active
                        AND NOT ok.needs_reauth
                        AND (raw.lease_until IS NULL
                            OR raw.lease_until < now())
                    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                        SELECT
                            first.due,
                            first.id
                        FROM
                            email_links l
                            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                                SELECT
                                    scoped.due,
                                    scoped.id
                                FROM (
                                    SELECT
                                        r.next_run_at AS due,
                                        r.id
                                    FROM
                                        email_sync_streams r
                                    WHERE
                                        r.link_id = l.id
                                        AND r.generation = l.sync_generation
                                        AND r.kind = 'folder_catalog'
                                        AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                        AND (r.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR r.provider_retry_at <= now())
                                        AND (r.lease_until IS NULL
                                            OR r.lease_until < now())
                                        OFFSET 0) scoped
                                ORDER BY
                                    scoped.due,
                                    scoped.id
                                LIMIT 1)
                            first
                        WHERE
                            ok.id IS NULL
                            AND l.provider = $2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                            AND l.is_sync_active
                            AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                        ORDER BY
                            first.due,
                            first.id
                        LIMIT 1) h ON true
                WHERE
                    ok.id IS NOT NULL
                    OR h.id IS NOT NULL)
                AND (s.lease_until IS NULL
                    OR s.lease_until < now())
            ORDER BY
                s.next_run_at,
                s.id
            LIMIT 1
            FOR UPDATE
                OF s SKIP LOCKED
            )
            UPDATE
                email_sync_streams s
            SET
                lease_id = $1,
                lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',
                lease_started_at = clock_timestamp(),
                leased_notification_revision = s.notification_revision,
                provider_retry_at = NULL,
                fence = fence + 1
            FROM
                candidate c,
                email_links l
            WHERE
                s.id = c.id
                AND l.id = s.link_id
            RETURNING
                s.id,
                s.link_id,
                s.generation,
                l.grant_generation,
                s.fence

catalog_commit.sql:
UPDATE
                email_sync_streams s
            SET
                initial_complete = true,
                last_completed_at = now(),
                next_run_at = CASE
                    WHEN s.provider = 'IMAP' THEN CASE
                        WHEN s.notification_revision > s.leased_notification_revision THEN now()
                        ELSE now() + interval '5 minutes'
                    END
                    WHEN notified_at > lease_started_at THEN now()
                    ELSE now() + interval '5 minutes'
                END,
                lease_id = NULL,
                lease_until = NULL
            FROM
                email_links l
            WHERE
                s.id = $1 AND s.lease_id = $2 AND s.fence = $3
                AND s.lease_until > now() AND l.id = s.link_id AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                AND l.is_sync_active AND l.grant_generation = $4

catchup_claim.sql:
WITH available AS (
                SELECT
                    id
                FROM
                    email_imap_host_catchup
                WHERE
                    id = 1
                    AND available_at <= now()
                    AND (lease_id IS NULL OR lease_until < now())
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            )
            UPDATE
                email_imap_host_catchup j
            SET
                lease_id = $1,
                lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => $2),
                mode = CASE WHEN startup_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'startup' ELSE mode END,
                stream_after = CASE WHEN mode = 'pending' AND startup_requested_at IS NOT NULL
                    THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid ELSE stream_after END,
                cycle_started_at = CASE WHEN stream_after = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid
                    OR (mode = 'pending' AND startup_requested_at IS NOT NULL)
                    THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE cycle_started_at END
            FROM
                available a
            WHERE
                j.id = a.id
            RETURNING
                j.stream_after,
                j.mode

                attempts,
                floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - created_at))::bigint AS "age!"

            ORDER BY

catchup_deferred_upsert.sql:
INSERT INTO email_imap_host_catchup_deferred (
                stream_id,
                available_at,
                attempts
            )
            SELECT
                id,
                clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds',
                1
            FROM
                unnest($1::uuid[]) AS rows(id)
            ON CONFLICT
                (stream_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                attempts = LEAST(email_imap_host_catchup_deferred.attempts + 1, 1000000),
                available_at = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => LEAST(
                    30 * power(2, LEAST(email_imap_host_catchup_deferred.attempts, 4)), 300
                ))

catchup_save.sql:
UPDATE
                email_imap_host_catchup
            SET
                stream_after = CASE WHEN $3 THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid ELSE $2 END,
                mode = CASE WHEN $3 THEN 'pending' ELSE mode END,
                startup_requested_at = CASE WHEN $3 AND $4 THEN NULL ELSE startup_requested_at END,
                last_startup_completed_at = CASE WHEN $3 AND $4 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE last_startup_completed_at END,
                lease_id = NULL,
                lease_until = NULL,
                available_at = CASE WHEN startup_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT $4 THEN now()
                    WHEN $3 THEN now() + make_interval(secs => $5) ELSE now() END,
                batches = batches + 1,
                streams_scanned = streams_scanned + $6,
                streams_woken = streams_woken + $7,
                streams_deferred = streams_deferred + $8,
                streams_failed = streams_failed + $9,
                updated_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE
                id = 1
                AND lease_id = $1
                AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()

catchup_wake_one.sql:
WITH owned AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT
                    id
                FROM
                    email_imap_host_catchup
                WHERE
                    id = 1
                    AND lease_id = $1
                    AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()
                FOR UPDATE
            ), candidate AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT
                    s.id,
                    (
                        l.is_sync_active
                        AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                        AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                        AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                        AND l.provider = 'IMAP'
                    ) AS eligible
                FROM
                    email_sync_streams s
                JOIN
                    email_links l ON l.id = s.link_id
                CROSS JOIN
                    owned
                WHERE
                    s.id = $2
                    AND s.provider = 'IMAP'
                    AND s.kind IN ('folder_catalog', 'mail_folder')
                FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
                FOR KEY SHARE OF l SKIP LOCKED
            ), updated AS (
                UPDATE
                    email_sync_streams s
                SET
                    notified_at = CASE
                        WHEN c.eligible THEN clock_timestamp()
                        ELSE s.notified_at
                    END,
                    notified_traceparent = CASE
                        WHEN c.eligible THEN $4
                        ELSE s.notified_traceparent
                    END,
                    notification_revision = CASE
                        WHEN c.eligible AND $3 THEN s.notification_revision + 1
                        ELSE s.notification_revision
                    END,
                    leased_notification_revision = CASE
                        WHEN NOT c.eligible AND (s.lease_id IS NULL OR s.lease_until < now())
                            THEN s.notification_revision
                        ELSE s.leased_notification_revision
                    END,
                    next_run_at = CASE
                        WHEN c.eligible THEN GREATEST(
                            LEAST(s.next_run_at, clock_timestamp()),
                            s.provider_retry_at
                        )
                        ELSE s.next_run_at
                    END
                FROM
                    candidate c
                WHERE
                    s.id = c.id
                    AND (
                        (c.eligible AND ($3 OR s.next_run_at > GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), s.provider_retry_at)))
                        OR (NOT c.eligible AND s.notification_revision > s.leased_notification_revision)
                    )
                RETURNING
                    c.eligible AS woken
            )
            SELECT
                (
                    SELECT
                        eligible
                    FROM
                        candidate
                ) AS woken,
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        email_sync_streams
                    WHERE
                        id = $2
                ) AS "exists!"

commit_page.sql:
UPDATE
                email_sync_streams s
            SET
                position = $4,
                initial_complete = s.initial_complete OR $5,
                -- A round's first page records the reader revision it started at,
                -- and when: the claim that read it.
                reader_revision = CASE WHEN s.position IS NULL THEN $7 ELSE s.reader_revision END,
                round_started_at = CASE WHEN s.position IS NULL THEN s.lease_started_at ELSE s.round_started_at END,
                last_completed_at = CASE WHEN $5 THEN now() ELSE last_completed_at END,
                next_run_at = CASE
                    WHEN s.provider = 'IMAP' THEN CASE
                        WHEN $5 AND s.notification_revision <= s.leased_notification_revision
                            THEN now() + interval '2 minutes'
                        ELSE now()
                    END
                    WHEN $5 AND (s.notified_at IS NULL OR s.notified_at <= s.lease_started_at)
                        THEN now() + interval '2 minutes'
                    ELSE now()
                END,
                -- A checkpoint that started reading after the notification has
                -- answered it; a deferred or partial read leaves it pending.
                notified_at = CASE
                    WHEN s.provider = 'IMAP' THEN CASE
                        WHEN $5 AND s.notification_revision <= s.leased_notification_revision THEN NULL
                        ELSE s.notified_at
                    END
                    WHEN $5 AND s.notified_at <= s.lease_started_at THEN NULL
                    ELSE s.notified_at
                END,
                lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL
            FROM
                email_links l
            WHERE
                s.id = $1 AND s.lease_id = $2 AND s.fence = $3
                AND s.lease_until > now() AND s.link_id = l.id AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                AND l.is_sync_active AND l.grant_generation = $6

import_backpressure_release.sql:
WITH queued AS (
                SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM (
                    SELECT 1 FROM email_message_reconciliation
                    WHERE link_id = $1 AND generation = $2 AND is_import AND available_at <> 'infinity'
                        AND available_at <= now()
                    LIMIT $3
                ) q
            )
            UPDATE email_sync_streams s SET lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_run_at = GREATEST(now() + make_interval(secs => $7), s.provider_retry_at)
            FROM queued WHERE queued.rows >= $3 AND s.id = $4 AND s.lease_id = $5 AND s.fence = $6

import_claim.sql:
WITH import_round AS (
                        SELECT
                            s.id,
                            s.notified_traceparent,
                            s.next_run_at - make_interval(secs => $2) AS claim_order
                        FROM
                            email_sync_streams s
                            JOIN email_links l ON l.id = s.link_id
                        WHERE
                            l.is_sync_active
                            AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                            AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                            AND l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                            AND s.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                            AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                            AND s.kind = 'mail_folder'
                            AND NOT s.initial_complete
                            AND s.next_run_at <= now()
                            AND (s.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR s.provider_retry_at <= now())
                            AND (s.next_run_at,
                                s.id) >= (
                                SELECT
                                    COALESCE(h.due, raw.due),
                                    COALESCE(h.id, raw.id)
                                FROM (
                                    SELECT
                                        r.next_run_at AS due,
                                        r.id,
                                        r.link_id,
                                        r.generation,
                                        r.lease_until
                                    FROM
                                        email_sync_streams r
                                    WHERE
                                        r.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                        AND r.kind = 'mail_folder'
                                        AND NOT r.initial_complete
                                        AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                        AND (r.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR r.provider_retry_at <= now())
                                    ORDER BY
                                        r.next_run_at,
                                        r.id
                                    LIMIT 1) raw
                            LEFT JOIN email_links ok ON ok.id = raw.link_id
                                AND ok.sync_generation = raw.generation
                                AND ok.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                AND ok.is_sync_active
                                AND NOT ok.needs_reauth
                                AND ok.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                                AND (raw.lease_until IS NULL
                                    OR raw.lease_until < now())
                            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                                SELECT
                                    first.due,
                                    first.id
                                FROM
                                    email_links l
                                    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                                        SELECT
                                            scoped.due,
                                            scoped.id
                                        FROM (
                                            SELECT
                                                r.next_run_at AS due,
                                                r.id
                                            FROM
                                                email_sync_streams r
                                            WHERE
                                                r.link_id = l.id
                                                AND r.generation = l.sync_generation
                                                AND r.kind = 'mail_folder'
                                                AND NOT r.initial_complete
                                                AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                                AND (r.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR r.provider_retry_at <= now())
                                                AND (r.lease_until IS NULL
                                                    OR r.lease_until < now())
                                                OFFSET 0) scoped
                                        ORDER BY
                                            scoped.due,
                                            scoped.id
                                        LIMIT 1)
                                    first
                                WHERE
                                    ok.id IS NULL
                                    AND l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                    AND l.is_sync_active
                                    AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                                    AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                                ORDER BY
                                    first.due,
                                    first.id
                                LIMIT 1) h ON true
                        WHERE
                            ok.id IS NOT NULL
                            OR h.id IS NOT NULL)
                        AND (s.lease_until IS NULL
                            OR s.lease_until < now())
                    ORDER BY
                        s.next_run_at,
                        s.id
                    LIMIT 1
                    FOR UPDATE
                        OF s SKIP LOCKED
                    ),
                    longest_due AS (
                        SELECT
                            s.id,
                            s.notified_traceparent,
                            s.next_run_at AS claim_order
                        FROM
                            email_sync_streams s
                            JOIN email_links l ON l.id = s.link_id
                        WHERE
                            l.is_sync_active
                            AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                            AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                            AND l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                            AND s.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                            AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                            AND s.kind = 'mail_folder'
                            AND s.next_run_at <= now()
                            AND (s.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR s.provider_retry_at <= now())
                            AND (s.next_run_at,
                                s.id) >= (
                                SELECT
                                    COALESCE(h.due, raw.due),
                                    COALESCE(h.id, raw.id)
                                FROM (
                                    SELECT
                                        r.next_run_at AS due,
                                        r.id,
                                        r.link_id,
                                        r.generation,
                                        r.lease_until
                                    FROM
                                        email_sync_streams r
                                    WHERE
                                        r.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                        AND r.kind = 'mail_folder'
                                        AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                        AND (r.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR r.provider_retry_at <= now())
                                    ORDER BY
                                        r.next_run_at,
                                        r.id
                                    LIMIT 1) raw
                            LEFT JOIN email_links ok ON ok.id = raw.link_id
                                AND ok.sync_generation = raw.generation
                                AND ok.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                AND ok.is_sync_active
                                AND NOT ok.needs_reauth
                                AND ok.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                                AND (raw.lease_until IS NULL
                                    OR raw.lease_until < now())
                            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                                SELECT
                                    first.due,
                                    first.id
                                FROM
                                    email_links l
                                    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                                        SELECT
                                            scoped.due,
                                            scoped.id
                                        FROM (
                                            SELECT
                                                r.next_run_at AS due,
                                                r.id
                                            FROM
                                                email_sync_streams r
                                            WHERE
                                                r.link_id = l.id
                                                AND r.generation = l.sync_generation
                                                AND r.kind = 'mail_folder'
                                                AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                                AND (r.provider_retry_at IS NULL OR r.provider_retry_at <= now())
                                                AND (r.lease_until IS NULL
                                                    OR r.lease_until < now())
                                                OFFSET 0) scoped
                                        ORDER BY
                                            scoped.due,
                                            scoped.id
                                        LIMIT 1)
                                    first
                                WHERE
                                    ok.id IS NULL
                                    AND l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                    AND l.is_sync_active
                                    AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                                    AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                                ORDER BY
                                    first.due,
                                    first.id
                                LIMIT 1) h ON true
                        WHERE
                            ok.id IS NOT NULL
                            OR h.id IS NOT NULL)
                        AND (s.lease_until IS NULL
                            OR s.lease_until < now())
                    ORDER BY
                        s.next_run_at,
                        s.id
                    LIMIT 1
                    FOR UPDATE
                        OF s SKIP LOCKED
                    ),
                    candidate AS (
                        SELECT
                            c.id,
                            c.notified_traceparent
                        FROM (
                            SELECT
                                *
                            FROM
                                import_round
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT
                                *
                            FROM
                                longest_due) c
                        ORDER BY
                            c.claim_order,
                            c.id
                        LIMIT 1)
                    -- The trace context is handed over once: retries get traces of
                    -- their own, so a long deferral can't grow the webhook's trace.
                    UPDATE
                        email_sync_streams s
                    SET
                        lease_id = $1,
                        lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',
                    lease_started_at = clock_timestamp(),
                    leased_notification_revision = s.notification_revision,
                    provider_retry_at = NULL,
                    fence = fence + 1,
                    notified_traceparent = NULL
                    FROM
                        candidate c,
                        email_links l
                    WHERE
                        s.id = c.id
                        AND l.id = s.link_id
                    RETURNING
                        s.id,
                        s.link_id,
                        s.generation,
                        l.grant_generation,
                        s.scope_id,
                        s.position,
                        s.initial_complete,
                        s.fence,
                        s.notified_at,
                        c.notified_traceparent,
                        s.import_started_at

init_wake.sql:
UPDATE
                    email_sync_streams
                SET

UPDATE email_sync_streams s SET position = $4,
                initial_complete = s.initial_complete OR $5,
                -- A round's first page records the reader revision it started at,
                -- and when: the claim that read it.
                reader_revision = CASE WHEN s.position IS NULL THEN $7 ELSE s.reader_revision END,
                round_started_at = CASE WHEN s.position IS NULL THEN s.lease_started_at ELSE s.round_started_at END,
                last_completed_at = CASE WHEN $5 THEN now() ELSE last_completed_at END,
                next_run_at = CASE WHEN $5 AND (s.notified_at IS NULL OR s.notified_at <= s.lease_started_at)
                    THEN now() + interval '2 minutes' ELSE now() END,
                -- A checkpoint that started reading after the notification has
                -- answered it; a deferred or partial read leaves it pending.
                notified_at = CASE WHEN $5 AND s.notified_at <= s.lease_started_at THEN NULL ELSE s.notified_at END,

            FROM email_links l WHERE s.id = $1 AND s.lease_id = $2 AND s.fence = $3

                            AND s.next_run_at <= now()
                            AND (s.next_run_at,
                                s.id) >= (
                                SELECT
                                    COALESCE(h.due, raw.due),
                                    COALESCE(h.id, raw.id)
                                FROM (
                                    SELECT
                                        r.next_run_at AS due,
                                        r.id,
                                        r.link_id,
                                        r.generation,
                                        r.lease_until
                                    FROM
                                        email_sync_streams r
                                    WHERE
                                        r.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                        AND r.kind = $2
                                        AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                    ORDER BY
                                        r.next_run_at,
                                        r.id
                                    LIMIT 1) raw
                            LEFT JOIN email_links ok ON ok.id = raw.link_id
                                AND ok.sync_generation = raw.generation
                                AND ok.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                AND ok.is_sync_active
                                AND NOT ok.needs_reauth
                                AND ok.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                                AND (raw.lease_until IS NULL
                                    OR raw.lease_until < now())
                            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                                SELECT
                                    first.due,
                                    first.id
                                FROM
                                    email_links l
                                    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                                        SELECT
                                            scoped.due,
                                            scoped.id
                                        FROM (
                                            SELECT
                                                r.next_run_at AS due,
                                                r.id
                                            FROM
                                                email_sync_streams r
                                            WHERE
                                                r.link_id = l.id
                                                AND r.generation = l.sync_generation
                                                AND r.kind = $2
                                                AND r.next_run_at <= now()
                                                AND (r.lease_until IS NULL
                                                    OR r.lease_until < now())
                                                OFFSET 0) scoped
                                        ORDER BY
                                            scoped.due,
                                            scoped.id
                                        LIMIT 1)
                                    first
                                WHERE
                                    ok.id IS NULL
                                    AND l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                                    AND l.is_sync_active
                                    AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                                    AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                                ORDER BY
                                    first.due,
                                    first.id
                                LIMIT 1) h ON true
                        WHERE
                            ok.id IS NOT NULL
                            OR h.id IS NOT NULL)
                        AND (s.lease_until IS NULL
                            OR s.lease_until < now())
                    ORDER BY
                        s.next_run_at,
                        s.id
                    LIMIT 1
                    FOR UPDATE
                        OF s SKIP LOCKED)
                    -- The trace context is handed over once: retries get traces of
                    -- their own, so a long deferral can't grow the webhook's trace.
                    UPDATE
                        email_sync_streams s
                    SET
                        lease_id = $1,
                        lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',
                    lease_started_at = clock_timestamp(),
                    fence = fence + 1,
                    notified_traceparent = NULL
                    FROM
                        candidate c,
                        email_links l
                    WHERE
                        s.id = c.id
                        AND l.id = s.link_id
                    RETURNING
                        s.id,
                        s.link_id,
                        s.generation,
                        l.grant_generation,
                        s.scope_id,
                        s.position,
                        s.initial_complete,
                        s.fence,
                        s.notified_at,
                        c.notified_traceparent,
                        s.import_started_at

notify_wake.sql:
UPDATE
                    email_sync_streams
                SET
                    notified_at = clock_timestamp(),
                    notified_traceparent = $3,
                    next_run_at = now()
                WHERE
                    link_id = $1
                    AND generation = $2
                    AND kind IN ('folder_catalog', 'mail_folder')

reimport_reset.sql:
UPDATE email_sync_streams s SET position = NULL, initial_complete = false,
                attachments_rechecked = s.attachments_rechecked AND NOT $5,
                next_run_at = now(), fence = s.fence + 1, lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL
            FROM email_mailbox_folders f
            WHERE s.link_id = $1 AND s.generation = $2 AND s.kind = 'mail_folder'
                AND f.link_id = s.link_id AND f.provider_id = s.scope_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND (s.reader_revision IS NULL OR s.reader_revision < $3)
                AND (f.role IN ('inbox','sent')) = $4
            RETURNING s.scope_id

release_stream_and_catalog.sql:
UPDATE email_sync_streams SET lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_run_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $4)
            WHERE id = $1 AND lease_id = $2 AND fence = $3

reset_import_round.sql:
UPDATE email_sync_streams s SET position = NULL,initial_complete = false,attachments_rechecked = false,next_run_at = now(),lease_id = NULL,lease_until = NULL
            FROM email_links l WHERE s.id = $1 AND s.lease_id = $2 AND s.fence = $3
                AND s.lease_until > now() AND l.id = s.link_id AND l.sync_generation = s.generation
                AND l.is_sync_active AND l.grant_generation = $4

restart_live_pass.sql:
UPDATE email_sync_streams s SET position = NULL,import_started_at = now(),next_run_at = now(),lease_id = NULL,lease_until = NULL
            FROM email_links l WHERE s.id = $1 AND s.lease_id = $2 AND s.fence = $3
                AND s.lease_until > now() AND l.id = s.link_id AND l.sync_generation = s.generation
                AND l.is_sync_active AND l.grant_generation = $4

watch_wake.sql: UPDATE email_sync_streams SET notified_at=clock_timestamp(),notified_traceparent=$3,next_run_at=LEAST(next_run_at,now()) WHERE link_id=$1 AND generation=$2 AND kind IN ('folder_catalog','mail_folder','mail_folder_live')

resync_floor.sql:
SELECT
                max(s.provider_retry_at)
            FROM
                email_sync_streams s
            LEFT JOIN
                email_mailbox_folders f
                ON f.link_id = s.link_id
                AND f.provider_id = s.scope_id
                AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
            WHERE
                s.link_id = $1
                AND s.generation = $2
                AND s.provider = 'IMAP'
                AND s.provider_retry_at > now()
                AND (s.kind = 'folder_catalog' OR f.role = 'inbox')
